text:
maria: Hey team — AxiomCorp just dropped an RFP. They want a filled capability matrix, SOC2 attestation, answers to the security questionnaire, pricing band for 100k tokens/month, and a 2‑week POC timeline. Can we split ownership?

tyler: I can run the POC infra and set up Dedicated if they want it. Quick Q: do they require on‑prem or just VPC/private?

maria: @tyler they indicated 'private deployment preferred' in the email but said hosted is acceptable if we provide isolation guarantees. I forwarded the PDF.

samir: For the capability matrix — model variants we can serve: gpt-ish open models + quantized 8bit/4bit. Latency SLOs: 95th pct ~ 120ms for short prompts on Dedicated. Note: dynamic batching will change costs.

liz: Pricing note — for 100k tokens/month: hosted ~$0.02/token (example), Dedicated reserved plan (monthly commit) better. I'll prepare 2 scenarios: self‑serve hosted and 12mo committed Dedicated.

maria: Great. @samir can you add a short row in the matrix about 'fallback/rollout behavior' and 'canary support'? Customer cares about graceful degradation.

samir: Added a CSV snippet draft:
```
feature,redwood_support,notes
model-catalog,yes,verified variants + quant profiles
canary-rollout,yes,automated traffic split + rollback
kv-caching,yes,prefix+response caching
quantization,8bit/4bit,perf tradeoffs noted
```

security-bot: (automated) Attached: SOC2 Type II summary, encryption-at-rest whitepaper, and our customer data handling policy. See attachments: soc2-summary.pdf, kms-integration.pdf.

jenny-sales: Nice. I'll send the capability matrix + answers and propose the POC kickoff meeting for next Tue 9am PT. Maria — can you own the security questionnaire responses?

maria: Yes, I'll draft responses to the security questionnaire today and tag @samir for any technical clarifications. I'll also note third‑party audits and KMS details.

tyler: POC infra plan: bring up a small Dedicated pool (2x A10G), pre-load model, run simulated traffic for 48h. I'll post the runbook in eng-releases.

liz: Once POC plan is confirmed, I'll lock in pricing bands and margin for enterprise discounts. Also need to confirm data retention ask — affects cost.

maria: Deadline: RFP due in 4 business days. Action items: liz — pricing scenarios, samir — capability CSV final, tyler — POC runbook, me — security questionnaire. Jenny to coordinate customer calendar.

jenny-sales: Got it. I'll schedule kickoff and ping legal for the RA (review agreement). :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks all — small deliverables today, otherwise we won't make the deadline.
